package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/xraph/fabriq"
	"github.com/xraph/fabriq/core/command"
	"github.com/xraph/fabriq/core/registry"
	"github.com/xraph/fabriq/core/tenant"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	cfg := fabriq.Config{
		Postgres: fabriq.PostgresConfig{DSN: os.Getenv("FABRIQ_POSTGRES_DSN")},
		Redis: fabriq.RedisConfig{Addr: os.Getenv("FABRIQ_REDIS_ADDR"), Username: os.Getenv("FABRIQ_REDIS_USERNAME"), Password: os.Getenv("FABRIQ_REDIS_PASSWORD")},
		Dynamic: fabriq.DynamicConfig{Persist: true},
	}
	f, _, err := fabriq.Open(ctx, registry.New(), cfg)
	if err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("open: %w", err) }
	spec := registry.EntitySpec{Name: "library_note", Kind: registry.KindAggregate,
		Schema: &registry.DynamicSchema{Table: "ds_library_note", Columns: []registry.DynamicColumn{{Name: "title", Type: registry.ColText}}}}
	if err := f.DefineDynamic(ctx, spec); err != nil { _ = f.Close(); return fmt.Errorf("define: %w", err) }
	tenantCtx, err := tenant.WithTenant(ctx, "acme")
	if err != nil { _ = f.Close(); return err }
	created, err := f.Exec(tenantCtx, command.Command{Entity: "library_note", Op: command.OpCreate, Payload: map[string]any{"title": "library-round-trip"}})
	if err != nil { _ = f.Close(); return fmt.Errorf("create: %w", err) }
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil { return err }
	reg := registry.New()
	reopened, _, err := fabriq.Open(ctx, reg, cfg)
	if err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("reopen: %w", err) }
	defer reopened.Close()
	if _, ok := reg.Get("library_note"); !ok { return fmt.Errorf("dynamic schema did not persist") }
	var row map[string]any
	if err := reopened.Relational().Get(tenantCtx, "library_note", created.AggID, &row); err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("read: %w", err) }
	if row["title"] != "library-round-trip" { return fmt.Errorf("entity data did not persist") }
	fmt.Println("library schema and entity survived reopen")
	return nil
}
